title: Harvesting SSH Credentials: Insights from my Honeypot Network
excerpt: I’ve been working on this honeypot network for the past couple of months, and I’d now like to share some information from the first 30 days.
content_html:
I’ve been working on this honeypot network for the past couple of months, and I’d now like to share some information from the first 30 days.

In this article::

  • Intro and short summary
  • the Data - credentials, attack sources, and so on
  • the Tech - servers, automation, honeypot
  • the Future - some plans and next steps

The project is still work-in-progress and I plan to improve it over time. The presentation is still a little bit rough, but this will do for now.

Feedback and questions are welcome!

Intro #

Locations of honeypots

References for this article:
- Timeframe = July 2026
- 15 servers (only dedicated for this purpose)
- 15 IPs, IPv4
- all over the world (see above)
- 5 VPS Providers
- SSH Honeypot, Port 22/TCP

The Data #

Some things to consider before we start:

  • Most honeypots are currently in Europe (60%) - I plan to add more
  • Passwords and usernames are percent-encoded (like an URL) to provide the information lossless and fully reversible - use Cyberchef to reverse it.
  • Only login attempts are considered - scans or other attacks are not (yet)!
  • I can’t publish the IPs of the attackers as I am not yet familiar with the privacy laws

Presentation is still rough, but will improve with next versions.

Total Login Attempts: 1,531,053

The Tech #

I’ll keep it simple - still a mess, but a top-level view might still be interesting.

Servers Management and Automation #

  • Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS or 26.04 LTS
  • Automation with Ansible
  • Onboarding
    • User creation
    • Installation required software
    • Basic config
  • Wireguard VPN Setup
    • Config for connection to central management server
    • FW rules
  • SSH Setup
    • SSHD listening only on VPN IP and Port 2222 (to avoid any conflicts)
    • the usual hardening (public key, etc)
  • Honeypot Setup
    • Runs as a rootless Podman container (Systemd service via Quadlet)
    • Port 22 as non-root with net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port

Side note: Ansible can be a bitch.

The SSH Honeypot #

Found some open-source candidates but they were either too ‘old’ or bloated so I’ve decided to do myself with the help of AI. I’ve used Python and Paramiko for the SSH handling.

The source code - I might publish a manual and the Ansible/Podman Quadlet file.

In short: low-interaction honeypot for SSH that saves the logs locally. Gathering the logs is being done with Ansible as well.

Additionally IP Information #

Been using ipgeolocation.io to fetch the additional information about the GEO locations, ASN information, etc.

Not affiliated or sponsored.

Reports #

  • Bash madness + LibreOffice (you don’t want to know)

The Future #

I’ve got some plans for this project - feel free to share your ideas as well.

  • better presentation and more detailed analysis
  • more automation (gathering, reporting)
  • different honeypots (DB, web, FTP, etc)
  • more servers and IPs
  • IPv6?
  • hashes for passwords
  • cross references with password lists
  • sharing intel with abuseIPDB and other projects
  • informing provider
  • live-dashboard

I’ve been working on a roadmap - but it will take a while.

Thank you for reading! As mentioned before, I’d like to hear your feedback or questions in the comments below.

content_html_zh:
过去几个月我一直在研究这个蜜罐网络，现在我想分享一下前 30 天的一些信息。

在本文中：：

  • 简介和简短摘要
  • 数据 - 凭证、攻击源等
  • 技术 - 服务器、自动化、蜜罐
  • 未来 - 一些计划和后续步骤

该项目仍在进行中，我计划随着时间的推移对其进行改进。 演示仍然有点粗糙，但现在就这样了。

欢迎反馈和提问！

Intro #

蜜罐的位置

References for this article:
- Timeframe = July 2026
- 15 servers (only dedicated for this purpose)
- 15 IPs, IPv4
- all over the world (see above)
- 5 VPS Providers
- SSH Honeypot, Port 22/TCP

  • 我无法公布攻击者的 IP，因为我还不熟悉隐私法

技术#

我会保持简单——仍然很混乱，但顶层视图可能仍然很有趣。

服务器管理和自动化 #

  • Ubuntu 服务器 24.04 LTS 或 26.04 LTS
  • 使用 Ansible 实现自动化
  • 入职 用户创建 安装所需软件 基本配置
  • Wireguard VPN 设置用于连接到中央管理服务器固件规则的配置
  • SSH 设置 SSHD 仅侦听 VPN IP 和端口 2222（以避免任何冲突）通常的强化（公钥等）
  • 蜜罐设置 作为无根 Podman 容器运行（通过 Quadlet 的 Systemd 服务） 端口 22 作为非根用户使用 net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port

旁注：Ansible 可能是个混蛋。

SSH 蜜罐#

找到了一些开源候选者，但它们要么太“旧”，要么太臃肿，所以我决定在人工智能的帮助下自己做。 我使用 Python 和 Paramiko 进行 SSH 处理。
